```yaml
name: Build macOS arm64 binary

on:
  release:
    types: [published]

permissions:
  contents: write

jobs:
  build-macos:
    runs-on: macos-14
    steps:
      - name: Checkout source repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Set up Python
        uses: actions/setup-python@v5
        with:
          python-version: '3.11'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: |
          python -m pip install --upgrade pip
          pip install -r requirements.txt
          pip install pyinstaller

      - name: Build PyInstaller binary
        run: |
          pyinstaller --onefile --distpath dist --name a2a-scanner a2a_scanner.py

      - name: Create tar.gz archive
        run: |
          TAG=${{ github.ref_name }}
          tar -czf a2a-scanner-${TAG}-arm64.tar.gz -C dist a2a-scanner

      - name: Upload asset to release
        uses: actions/upload-release-asset@v1
        with:
          upload_url: ${{ github.event.release.upload_url }}
          asset_path: a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}-arm64.tar.gz
          asset_name: a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}-arm64.tar.gz
          asset_content_type: application/gzip
          github_token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Compute SHA256
        id: sha
        run: |
          echo "sha=$(shasum -a 256 a2a-scanner-${{ github.ref_name }}-arm64.tar.gz | awk '{print $1}')" >> $GITHUB_OUTPUT

      - name: Checkout Homebrew tap
        uses: actions/checkout@v4
        with:
          repository: cisco-ai-defense/homebrew-ai-defense
          token: ${{ secrets.HOMEBREW_TAP_TOKEN }}
          path: homebrew-tap
          fetch-depth: 0

      - name: Update Homebrew formula
        run: |
          cd homebrew-tap
          TAG=${{ github.ref_name }}
          SHA=${{ steps.sha.outputs.sha }}
          sed -i '' -e "s/^  version .*/  version \"${TAG}\"/" Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          sed -i '' -e "s/^  sha256 .*/  sha256 \"${SHA}\"/" Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          git config user.name "github-actions[bot]"
          git config user.email "github-actions[bot]@users.noreply.github.com"
          git add Formula/a2a-scanner.rb
          git commit -m "Update a2a-scanner formula to ${TAG}"
          git push origin main
```
